description: Figure: sequence identity matrix across the CANSDH/CASDH panel and the agmatine-pocket residue mapping from PDB 38LX
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

im = pd.DataFrame(
 [[100.0,57.7,72.7,58.0,44.0,43.4,43.8,42.1],
  [57.7,100.0,63.5,56.6,45.6,44.8,46.3,40.4],
  [72.7,63.5,100.0,59.9,44.9,45.9,44.9,38.4],
  [58.0,56.6,59.9,100.0,40.0,40.6,39.4,36.3],
  [44.0,45.6,44.9,40.0,100.0,84.1,97.6,45.9],
  [43.4,44.8,45.9,40.6,84.1,100.0,83.8,43.9],
  [43.8,46.3,44.9,39.4,97.6,83.8,100.0,45.1],
  [42.1,40.4,38.4,36.3,45.9,43.9,45.1,100.0]],
 index=['S. pneumoniae D39\n(agmatine, PDB 38LX)','B. fragilis\n(2023+2026 kinetics)','C. leptum\n(2023+2026 kinetics)',
        'H. pylori\n(PDB 8H4Z, no kinetics)','V. alginolyticus CANSDH\n(1991 kinetics: DAP)','VC1624 V. cholerae\n(TARGET)',
        'V. parahaemolyticus','P. putida PP_2928'])
im.columns = im.index

pocket = pd.DataFrame({
 'S. pneumoniae (agmatine bound)':['P86','A107','N108','Y109','E110','F136','D162','P163','F202','I206','E210','H250','E251'],
 'B. fragilis (measured)':       ['P83','A104','N105','Y106','E107','F114','D140','P141','F180','I184','E188','H228','E229'],
 'C. leptum (measured)':         ['P85','A106','N107','Y108','E109','F116','D142','P143','F182','I186','E190','H230','E231'],
 'H. pylori':                    ['P72','A93','N94','Y95','E96','F103','D129','P130','F169','I173','E177','H217','E218'],
 'V. alginolyticus (measured DAP)':['P90','(S111)','(V112)','(S113)','(V114)','Q125','D151','P152','F191','T195','E199','H239','D240'],
 'VC1624 (target)':              ['P90','(S111)','(V112)','(S113)','(V114)','E125','D151','P152','F191','T195','E199','H239','D240'],
}, index=['P86 distal subsite','A107 distal floor','N108 distal cation (OD1/O)','Y109 2nd shell',
          'E110 distal cation (1.99 A)','F136 distal aromatic wall','D162 amine subsite (bb O)','P163 amine subsite',
          'F202 aromatic cradle','I206 chain wall','E210 mid-chain','H250 amine subsite','E251 distal cation (2.78 A)'])

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16.5,7.6))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(1,2,width_ratios=[1.0,1.25],wspace=0.38)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
imv=im.values
h=ax.imshow(imv,cmap='viridis',vmin=35,vmax=100)
ax.set_xticks(range(8)); ax.set_yticks(range(8))
ax.set_xticklabels([s.split('\n')[0] for s in im.index],rotation=55,ha='right',fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_yticklabels(im.index,fontsize=8)
for i in range(8):
    for j in range(8):
        ax.text(j,i,f"{imv[i,j]:.0f}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8,
                color='white' if imv[i,j]<72 else 'black')
ax.set_title('Pairwise sequence identity (%), Needleman-Wunsch / BLOSUM62',fontsize=10.5)
# highlight VC1624 row
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((-0.5,4.5),8,1,fill=False,edgecolor='crimson',lw=2.2))
fig.colorbar(h,ax=ax,fraction=0.046,label='% identity')

ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
cols=list(pocket.columns); rows=list(pocket.index)
ref=pocket[cols[0]].str.extract(r'([A-Z])')[0].values
grid=np.zeros((len(rows),len(cols)))
for j,c in enumerate(cols):
    for i,v in enumerate(pocket[c].values):
        aa=v.strip('()')[0]
        grid[i,j]= 0 if aa==ref[i] else 1
        if '(' in v: grid[i,j]=0.5
ax2.imshow(grid,cmap=plt.cm.colors.ListedColormap(['#dcefe4','#f6dfae','#f2b2a8']),vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect='auto')
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax2.set_xticklabels(cols,rotation=38,ha='right',fontsize=8.5)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(rows))); ax2.set_yticklabels(rows,fontsize=8.5)
for j,c in enumerate(cols):
    for i,v in enumerate(pocket[c].values):
        ax2.text(j,i,v,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8.5)
ax2.set_title('Agmatine-pocket residues of PDB 38LX mapped onto homologs\n'
              'green = same as reference, orange = alignment register uncertain, red = substituted',fontsize=10)
for s in ('top','right'): ax2.spines[s].set_visible(False)

fig.suptitle('VC1624 sits in a Vibrio CANSDH clade far from every enzyme with measured substrate kinetics,\n'
             'and differs from all of them inside the only experimentally observed amine-binding pocket',
             fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.93])
plt.show()
